lines.en: Hovering an inch up, I glide past.
My coat's hem sweeps the grass.
Ki in the step, so it lands light.
I walk, flexing my fist.
The air is easier to walk than the ground.
I lower my body and close in.
Three steps, a pause, a look around.
I land without a sound.
Ki pushes me forward.

lines.zh: 绕过这片碎石，我跳过去。
lines.en: Around the gravel — I leap it.

lines.zh: 这身体已经习惯了战斗。
lines.en: This body is used to fighting.

lines.zh: 我走得随意，但随时能停。
lines.en: An easy walk — but I can stop on a coin.
Arms folded, watching the distance.
The coat drifts slowly in the wind.
Holding my ki down.

lines.zh: 这具身体的反应比我想的快。
lines.en: This body reacts faster than I expect.
Looking for the next thing to do.
The grass bends under me.
I push my sleeve up.
In silence, I listen.
Ki is moving in the distance.
I don't much like waiting.
These hands could be faster.
Thinking about that last move.
My old shoulder aches.
Standing taut as a drawn string.
Your ki's stronger than it was.

lines.zh: 别站在我气场的正对面。
lines.en: Don't stand square in my aura.
Fight, or leave?
I don't have much patience.
You look prepared.
One sentence from you is enough.
That stance is self-taught.

lines.zh: 我见过更强的人，也打赢过。
lines.en: I've met stronger. I've beaten them.
That little ki won't be enough.
I'd advise you to step back.
You carry someone else's scent.
Want to test my speed?
I have already read your ki.
Your hand moves when you smile.
I've no hostility toward you. For now.

lines.zh: 你后退的样子我见过很多次。
lines.en: I've seen that retreat many times.
Scraped. Nothing serious.
This body takes hits well.
Half a step back, recharging ki.
My sleeve is soaked through with blood.
The pain passes quickly.
I can still fight. Don't stop.
My shoulder's gone numb.
The fist grazed me; my ki holds.
Food? I don't really need it.
Set it down. Don't hand it to me.
I eat fast and don't fuss.
This body eats more than before.
Smells good, but I'm busy.
After the fight.
Someone cooking out here?
Not picky, not polite about it.
Take it away. I'm charging ki.
Save it for someone who needs it.
That was my aura, not me.
Too close. Half a step back.
Bumping me doesn't hurt. You're the one who'll feel it.
I didn't land clean.
You caught my coat.

lines.zh: 我们速度都不慢，撞上了。
lines.en: We were both quick. Collision.
Clear a bit. I'm taking off.
Your shoulder knocked me crooked.
Brace yourself or my ki pushes you.
I've things I have to do.
This body shouldn't speak of that.
When all of this is over.
I'm not the settling kind.
Don't ask me about that.
I owe someone my life.
Maybe there'll be a chance later.
That topic splits my focus.
GT Trunks hasn't even warmed up.
This one's mine.
I pick it up and weigh it.
Something hard. Not heavy.
Into the coat pocket.
This is worth a little money.
Leave it. No time.
I duck and grab fast.
This stone's a decent throw.
I kick the shard aside.
You keep this one.
I feel it — east of here.
The ki flared up.
I'll move first. Stay out of it.
I can finish this in one strike.
He's hiding poorly.
Roughly fifteen paces away.
His aura is a jumble.
Marked. Don't step aside.
He raises his arm too slowly.
I'll handle this one.
No need for both of us.
I'll test his speed.
Don't blink. This ends quickly.
He's coming from the left.
I'm already moving in.
There's a ditch at his feet.
One more circle to see how he reacts.
He won't strike first.
Ki is pressed into my hands.
Half his guard is open.
Waiting for the wind — it favors me.
Two retreats, same spot.
Moving low along the ground.
Rush him and he'll show a gap.
There's a seam in his armor.
This angle favors me.
Higher — hit from above.
The hand on his weapon trembles.
I'm patient. He isn't.
That tree on the left gives cover.
A ki blast is ready at my hand.
He's retreating. He's afraid.
One strike. Aim true.

lines.zh: 连发的光弹追着你拐弯。
lines.en: My burst of ki blasts curves after you.
Aerial combo, driving down.
This kick comes from the side.
Burning strike — don't touch it.
I'm faster than your eyes.
Coming down on you.
Try and block this one.
The palm strikes flush against you.
Three hits, then out.
Ki bursts on impact.
He's backpedaling. I follow.
Conserving ki on this one.
Switch feet, strike the left side.
Don't block center — that's the hard part.
I hit your hands, not you.
Missed once. Again.
I drop out of the air.
My coat flips once on landing.
Ki spreads out around me.
Shoulders down, feet planted.

lines.zh: 这身体一到手就会战斗。
lines.en: This body fights the moment it's mine.
I look up and scan around.
Someone summoned me.
Ki under my soles holds me up.
Emptier here than I expected.
First, I work my wrists.
Brushing the dust off my coat.
The gravel jumps as I land.
One breath in, held.
I feel like I've seen this scene.
Rolling my sleeves to the elbow.
Quiet around me. Good for getting ready.
My toes ride an inch off the ground.
I listen first, then move.
Fire rolled over my coat and burned my arm.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: Fell from height and left a crater.
Underwater, my ki is useless.
The blast threw me up and down.
Something lodged in my side.
That spell is twisting my ki.
Too hungry to raise my ki.
Lightning ran crown to heel.
So dark that even ki slips away.
